summary: The bounded learner-aware repair was implemented exactly as scoped, and it did fix the diagnosed modelling error: belief went from 0.00 to 57.33 mean social utility with real learning and cost-contingent contributions. The gate still fails on the clauses you pre-committed to, so per your failure rule SCK feature development is stopped and engineering priority returns to StoryBox.

what_changed_and_nothing_else.change: EmpiricalOpponentModel: Laplace-smoothed frequencies of each other agent's observed contributions, updated only from public history, used for expected partner contribution by exact convolution in place of the fixed cost-threshold rule.
what_changed_and_nothing_else.no_forced_exploration: The contributions that appear are expected-value maximisation. The Laplace prior alone makes x=2 optimal for cost 1, which the pre-run analysis predicted and the implementation reproduces numerically at 20/64 = 0.3125 for P(success | x=0).

acceptance_gate_clause_by_clause.materially_exceed_previous_zero: PASSED for belief, 0.00 to 57.33. FAILED for belief_planning, still 0.00.
acceptance_gate_clause_by_clause.gain_from_corrected_expectations_not_a_s: PASSED for belief. Contributions are contingent on the private cost exactly as the corrected model implies, the posterior moved 6.6 times off the prior, and the effect is a per-type rule rather than a mirrored bloc or tie-break artifact.
acceptance_gate_clause_by_clause.must_not_preserve_a_pathological_all_zer: FAILED. belief still contributes zero in 70 percent of decisions and drifts from 0.675 to 0.725 toward the equilibrium rather than away from it. Universal defection is verified by computation to be a Nash equilibrium of the contract.
acceptance_gate_clause_by_clause.leakage_remains_zero: PASSED, and structurally zero rather than an achievement.

failure_rule_triggered.trigger: It does not beat the fixed cost-threshold policy in a meaningful way: 57.33 against 72.80 social utility and 0.394 against 0.554 efficiency. It also still free-rides pathologically with an upward drift into the verified all-zero equilibrium, and belief_planning still collapses.
failure_rule_triggered.action_taken: SCK feature development stopped. No option B, no MCTS, no nested theory of mind, no further custom benchmark, no StoryBox or risk-list reconnection.
retained: StrategicObservation and the actor-view information boundary with its runtime guard, decision-path AST audit and per-episode empirical check
BeliefState, EvidenceRecord, OpponentModel, StrategicDecision and CommunicationIntent interfaces
replay, audit and metric tooling, including the demoted immediate-target-loss diagnostic and the belief-discrimination flat-fraction health check
SecretMafia as a retained adversarial negative benchmark, and the mixed-motive Joint Project as a second retained negative benchmark
failure_rule_triggered.next_priority: StoryBox and novel work, as your decision directs.

structural_explanation_for_the_partial_r.why_the_repair_could_not_finish_the_job: The repair fixed the diagnosed modelling error and that was worth 57.33. The remaining obstacle is structural: with threshold 6 and a maximum contribution of 3, no single agent can make the project succeed, so universal defection is a Nash equilibrium and it is absorbing for any model that learns only from observed contributions. Escaping needs exploration or a commitment mechanism, both of which your decision excluded from this round.
structural_explanation_for_the_partial_r.why_belief_planning_regressed_and_that_i: Its pledge-conditioning treats each agent as honouring its pledge with its measured reliability. In an all-zero-pledge equilibrium every pledge is 0, so the model becomes strictly more pessimistic than the plain empirical one and locks in immediately at a believed success probability of 0.006. A credible-commitment channel that only mirrors equilibrium pledges actively harms the agent.

prerun_prediction_scorecard.P2_improvement_only_from_the_cheapest_ty: confirmed, c1 contributed while c2 and c4 did not
prerun_prediction_scorecard.P3_all_zero_is_absorbing_and_the_profile: confirmed, 0.675 to 0.725, and the equilibrium claim verified by computation
prerun_prediction_scorecard.P4_belief_stays_below_the_memory_heurist: FALSIFIED. I predicted it would stay below 43.50 and it reached 57.33. It did fail to beat the fixed cost-threshold rule at 72.80, which my prediction had not included in that comparison.
prerun_prediction_scorecard.score: six confirmed, one falsified, reported as falsified rather than dropped

honest_notes: The one falsified prediction is that belief would not beat the type-blind memory heuristic. It did beat it. I am not reinterpreting the prediction to claim it was about the fixed rule.

The type-inference Brier for belief, 0.558, is worse than belief_planning's 0.357 even though belief_planning learned nothing, because a do-nothing policy keeps near-prior marginals while an active one takes risks. That metric should not be read as belief_planning being better calibrated; believed versus realised success is the interpretable signal.
Own-authored substrate and 30 episodes, so this is smoke evidence. The decisive comparison does not rest on a fine margin: 72.80 against 57.33 and 0.554 against 0.394.

Two bugs were found by the tests while implementing and are reported rather than hidden: the Nash-equilibrium check initially indexed the contribution distribution backwards, which made partners contribute 3 instead of 0, and the previous round's uniform-posterior bug is the reason a pre-run numeric prediction was computed by hand this time.
action_required: No decision needed from you unless you disagree with applying your failure rule. SCK feature development is stopped and engineering priority returns to StoryBox and novel work. If the SCK line is ever revisited, the pre-run contract, the prediction file and both gate verdicts are the record to start from.
